entries.title: Treat simulations as diagnostics, not final balance authority
entries.summary: Simulations should instrument pacing and failure modes, but physical human playtests determine whether the game is fun, clear, and balanced.

entries.title: Ordinary games should usually finish before 100 player-turns
entries.summary: A practical pacing target emerged around 50–70 player-turns, with 100+ reserved for unusual games rather than the norm.

entries.title: Monitor deck cycling and Graveyard erosion explicitly
entries.summary: Playtests and simulations should track reshuffles, recyclable cards, incomplete draws, Graveyard size, and when card flow begins to degrade.
